Mumbai Landslide Kills at Least Seven Amid Heavy Rains

A landslide in Mumbai's Kurla area on Wednesday morning killed at least seven people, with several others feared trapped under debris. The incident occurred in Gaushiya Chawl following heavy monsoon rains. Rescue operations were immediately launched by fire brigade and police teams. The BMC Mayor announced ₹4 lakh for the next of kin of those deceased. Reports indicate between two and seven fatalities, with two to four people injured or trapped.
